name: sigstack-bot
description: Dev tooling for commitlint / husky (Rust app lives in crates/)

scripts.commitlint:branch: commitlint --from "$(git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null || git merge-base HEAD main 2>/dev/null || git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD)" --to HEAD --verbose
scripts.lint:rust: npm run fmt:check && npm run clippy
scripts.lint: npm run lint:rust && npm run lint:web
scripts.test:cov: cargo llvm-cov --workspace --html --output-dir target/llvm-cov --ignore-filename-regex '(^|/)main\.rs$' && cargo llvm-cov report --lcov --output-path target/llvm-cov/lcov.info
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.prepush: npm run lint && npm run test:cov:ci && npm run commitlint:branch
